headlines.title: 津巴布韦拟取消食品进口关税 缓冲作物短缺影响
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月2日讯，津巴布韦财政部长恩库贝表示，津巴布韦计划取消食品进口关税，以帮助缓冲厄尔尼诺天气模式可能造成的作物短缺对价格的影响。该措施是这个南部非洲国家将推出的一揽子计划的一部分，旨在缓冲这种气候冲击以及中东和俄乌冲突推高食品和燃料价格对生活成本的影响。他周五在津巴布韦第二大城市布拉瓦约对记者表示：“我们有一个六大或七大支柱战略。”他补充称，2027年经济增长仍预计为5%。

headlines.title_en: Zimbabwe plans to scrap food import tariffs to cushion the impact of crop shortages
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 2 — Zimbabwe Finance Minister Ncube said Zimbabwe plans to scrap tariffs on food imports to help cushion the impact on prices of possible crop shortages caused by the El Niño weather pattern. The measure is part of a package the southern African country will roll out to cushion the impact of this climate shock, as well as the impact on the cost of living from higher food and fuel prices driven by conflicts in the Middle East and between Russia and Ukraine. "We have a six- or seven-pillar strategy," he told reporters on Friday in Bulawayo, Zimbabwe's second-largest city, adding that economic growth is still expected to be 5% in 2027.

headlines.title_en: China's new home prices in 100 cities kept rising in September, while the decline in second-hand home prices widened
headlines.summary_en: Data released by the China Index Academy show that in September the average price of new homes in 100 Chinese cities was 17,285 yuan per square meter, up 0.17% month-on-month and up 2.12% year-on-year; <u>the average price of second-hand homes was 12,452 yuan per square meter, down 6.94% year-on-year and down 0.6% month-on-month, with the decline widening</u>. In key cities such as Shanghai and Beijing, <u>the launch of high-quality new projects drove a structural rise in new-home prices</u>; second-hand home transaction volumes in key cities rose year-on-year but prices fell, with Shanghai second-hand home prices turning from a decline to a rise month-on-month, up 0.11%. Cao Jingjing of the China Index Academy expects the property market to continue bottoming out in the fourth quarter, with new-home sales in core cities supported, while <u>second-hand home prices may continue to adjust in the short term</u>.

headlines.title_en: In the first half of this year, foreign direct investment of an equity nature rose 55% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange's "2026 First Half China International Balance of Payments Report" shows that in the first half of 2026, foreign equity direct investment was $63.8 billion, up 55% year-on-year. The report shows that within foreign equity direct investment, net capital contributions reflecting long-term investment willingness increased by $43.1 billion; reinvested earnings of foreign-invested enterprises within China rose 31% year-on-year, indicating that foreign-invested enterprises are using more of their operating income for investment and business development in China.

headlines.title: 截至8月底我国境内公募基金规模达39.63万亿元
headlines.summary: 中国基金业协会最新发布的数据显示，截至2026年8月底，我国境内公募基金资产净值合计39.63万亿元。截至2026年8月底，我国境内公募基金管理机构共165家，其中基金管理公司150家，取得公募资格的资产管理机构15家。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: As of the end of August, the scale of China's domestic public funds reached 39.63 trillion yuan
headlines.summary_en: The latest data released by the Asset Management Association of China show that as of the end of August 2026, the total net asset value of public funds in China was 39.63 trillion yuan. As of the end of August 2026, there were 165 public fund management institutions in China, including 150 fund management companies and 15 asset management institutions qualified for public fund management. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 日本经济财政大臣城内实：希望日本央行在政策引导方面继续与政府保持密切沟通
headlines.summary: 日本经济财政大臣城内实：希望日本央行在政策引导方面继续与政府保持密切沟通。 鉴于日本央行决定结束收益率曲线控制，日本已不再需要实施非常规货币刺激措施。 日本已不再处于通缩状态，因此无需采取过度宽松、推高通胀的货币政策。 高市政府的政策不同于旨在使日本摆脱通缩的再通胀政策。 高市政府的政策不同于安倍经济学，力求同时实现强劲经济和财政纪律，侧重提升日本的供给能力。

headlines.title_en: Japan's Economic and Fiscal Policy Minister Minoru Kiuchi: hopes BOJ will continue to maintain close communication with the government on policy guidance
headlines.summary_en: Japan's Minister of State for Economic and Fiscal Policy Minoru Kiuchi: He hopes the Bank of Japan will continue to maintain close communication with the government in policy guidance. Given the Bank of Japan's decision to end yield curve control, Japan no longer needs to implement unconventional monetary stimulus measures. Japan is no longer in deflation, so there is no need for excessively accommodative monetary policy that pushes up inflation. The Takaichi government's policy is different from reflationary policies aimed at pulling Japan out of deflation. The Takaichi government's policy is different from Abenomics, seeking to achieve both a strong economy and fiscal discipline, with a focus on enhancing Japan's supply capacity.
